prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Fort Lauderdale FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Luxury Property Care (LPC)** looks like a strong first company to interview for a long-term rental in Fort Lauderdale. It advertises local full-service management, tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, and eviction support. Its published pricing is **8–10% of rent collected**, plus a **one-time leasing fee of one month’s rent** when it places a new tenant; it says there’s no management fee while the home is vacant and no renewal or setup fee.

I’d compare it with **Real Property Management United**, which lists **7.9% and 9.9% management plans** plus a leasing fee, and **PMI Prime View**, which publishes several service tiers and fees. Ask each for a written, all-in quote and clarify maintenance markups, inspection frequency, lease-up costs, cancellation terms, and who approves repairs. Also check recent reviews and verify the company’s Florida real-estate licensing before signing.

[Luxury Property Care](https://luxurypropertycare.com/ft-lauderdale-property-management-service/) · [Real Property Management United pricing](https://www.unitedrpm.com/property-management-fees) · [PMI Prime View pricing](https://www.fortlauderdalepropertymanagementinc.com/pricing)
